• What we do

From large-scale infrastructure to modern real estate developments, our work combines innovation, reliability, and precision

Road Construction

SKA Group, with a deep understanding of market needs, shapes infrastructure and positively impacts the communities it serves.

Civil Works

We construct government buildings, labor and housing colonies, industrial structures, culverts, bridges, dams, canals, and railway tracks.

Mass Earth Excavation

We excavate large amounts of earth and rocks for canals, dams, and other development projects.

Loading and Transportation

We load and transport minerals, aggregates, and ores.

Foundation Excavation, Earthwork & Site Grading

We have a skilled team that efficiently handles foundation excavation, earthwork, and site grading.

Steel Manufacturing

We own a limestone lease, which gives us access to a vast supply of limestone.

Manufacturing of Stone

We have a wide range of stone products available, including crushed stone, sand, gravel, and other aggregates.

Dealing in Real Estate

We deal in real estate and have a wide range of properties available.
